product_metadata.title: Finnez Frosted Window Film Non-Adhesive, Frosting Privacy Film for Glass Windows, Self Static-Cling Decorative Window Cling for Home Office UV Protection Cross Pattern 11.8 x 78.7 inches
features: PROTECTION AND PRIVACY - Keep unwanted eyes away from your private indoor space and filter out strong sun glares and 96% of harmful UV rays with the top rated Finnez Window Film

EASY INSTALLATION – Finnez Window Film is super easy to install. The no glue, static cling application just takes a few minutes to apply and leaves absolutely no mess. It’s even easily removable for multiple uses and it doesn’t leave any sticky residue when you remove it.

BEAUTIFUL LOOK – Immediately transform any space with the luxurious frosted glass look this window film offers. The intricate engravings and clean-cut design offer an upscale and elegant appeal to any room it’s placed in.

USES AND DETAILS – Window film arrives rolled up and rolls out into two sizes; 17.8’’x78.7’’ and 35.4’’ x78.7’’. Finnez film can be used for glass windows, sliding doors, glass furniture and much more.
SATISFACTION GUARANTEE – Finnez is dedicated to providing 100% customer satisfaction. If you have any questions or concerns with your product, just send us an email and we will be here to help you.
